title: Periodic and Harmonic Periodic RoPE for Length Extrapolation in LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.27980v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The ability to process long contexts is crucial for large language models (LLMs) to perform long-horizon tasks. Rotary position embedding (RoPE) gives every token a new rotation angle, so a model eventually meets angles it never saw in training, i.e., position exhaustion. We propose Periodic RoPE (P-RoPE), a positional encoding mechanism that operates in conjunction with sliding window attention. It repeats the first sliding-window-size \(W\) angles of the RoPE table, so the model needs only \(W\) distinct angles. P-RoPE works but introduces a wrap error at the window boundary. We further propose Harmonic Periodic RoPE (HP-RoPE), which removes the error by choosing frequencies that complete whole turns in \(W\) tokens. We compare models that share the same architecture, data, and schedule and differ only in the window-layer position encoding: standard RoPE, P-RoPE, and HP-RoPE. The results show that P-RoPE and HP-RoPE keep perp

translated_title: 面向大语言模型长度外推的周期性与谐波周期性旋转位置编码（RoPE）
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.27980v2 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：处理长上下文的能力对大语言模型（LLM）执行长程任务至关重要。旋转位置编码（RoPE）为每个 token 分配一个新的旋转角度，因此模型最终会遇到训练中从未见过的角度，即“位置耗尽”问题。我们提出了周期性 RoPE（P-RoPE），一种与滑窗注意力配合使用的位置编码机制。它重复使用 RoPE 角度表中前 W 个（滑窗大小）角度，因此模型只需要 W 个不同的角度。P-RoPE 是有效的，但会在窗口边界处引入回绕误差。我们进一步提出了谐波周期性 RoPE（HP-RoPE），通过选择在 W 个 token 内恰好完成整数圈的频率来消除该误差。我们比较了架构、数据和训练计划完全相同、仅在窗口层位置编码上有所区别的三种模型：标准 RoPE、P-RoPE 和 HP-RoPE。结果表明，P-RoPE 和 HP-RoPE 能够保持困惑度（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出周期性 RoPE（P-RoPE）与谐波周期性 RoPE（HP-RoPE）两种位置编码机制，通过与滑窗注意力结合并仅复用 W 个旋转角度来缓解大语言模型长上下文外推中的位置耗尽问题，其中 HP-RoPE 借助在窗口内完成整数圈的谐波频率消除了窗口边界的回绕误差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Periodic RoPE (P-RoPE) and Harmonic Periodic RoPE (HP-RoPE), which combine with sliding window attention by reusing only W rotation angles to address position exhaustion in LLM length extrapolation, with HP-RoPE eliminating the wrap error at window boundaries through frequencies that complete whole turns within W tokens.
